mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 4.0% signals tight labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive returns in more than 55% of cases (both series rising, 20-day return negative).

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles triggered by FEDFUNDS exceeding 2.5% increase discount rates and reduce liquidity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Continuous monthly growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates sustained job market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS shows month-over-month growth.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 850.0 thousand units signal strong residential construction activity that boosts related sectors and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 850.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and decline in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates supply-demand imbalance where supply growth outpaces demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising INDPRO and falling RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases (INDPRO up, RSAFS down, 60-day return positive).

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion characterized by HOUST > 850.0 and RSAFS > 420,000 leads to overvaluation and profit-taking, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 850.0 and RSAFS > 420000.
